verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime and platform, not itself an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows Ollama serving models to agents through its REST, OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible APIs, plus launching coding tools. None of it documents an official MCP server or MCP endpoint that agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
